notes: The accepted alignment marked *he had done* `added` under rule 20. The comparative כְּשָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה gaps its verb, and *done* is the pro-verb naming the verb the clause beside it writes (הֶעֱלָה), which is exactly the case rule 34 carves out of rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb clause; the ASV writes the words in roman type.
Everything else stands, including the negation recast onto the object as *no* (rule 15) and the split of the distributive שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה, for which the ASV writes a word for each occurrence.
